title: Kadavul Irukaan Kumaru
desc: Kumar and his friend decide to celebrate the former's bachelor's party before his wedding. However, chaos ensues when the duo are caught by the police for carrying alcohol.

title: Lucky The Superstar
desc: Lucky, an exceptional and lost puppy, changes the lives of everyone she meets. Finally, she captures the interest of influential political forces, resulting in amusing mayhem and unforeseen upheaval.

title: Aaromaley
desc: An idealistic visionary is compelled to face the reality of life while working at a matrimonial firm. After failing in love due to his negligence, he gets another chance after years.

title: Chandi Veeran
desc: Upon returning to his village, Paari strives to resolve the long-standing water conflict that claimed his father's life years ago.

title: Udanpirappe
desc: Mathangi's husband is a law-abiding citizen while her brother advocates for fighting for justice. As their conflicting beliefs drive them apart, Mathangi struggles to bridge the rift between them.

title: Bharath Ennum Naan
desc: A graduate from Oxford is forced to take up his father's position as the chief minister after his sudden death. Later, he tries to reform the corrupt society but faces obstacles from his enemies.

title: Naalavathu Singam
desc: After moving to the city, Kalyan befriends GK, a notorious villain. Later, Kalyan regrets his actions when his friend ruthlessly murders an orphaned girl.

title: Panjumittai
desc: Appu and Kuppu are the best of friends since they were children. However, their friendship is threatened when the former suspects the latter of having an affair with his wife, Ranji.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Anbudan Appavuku
desc: After learning that his father lost all his wealth due to the wrongdoing of a cunning businessman, his son, Abhiram, seeks revenge.

title: Damaal Dumeel
desc: A young, money-minded IT professional leads a happy life, until he gets fired from his job.

title: Yengalai Pol Yaarum Illai
desc: A doctor living abroad returns to India to sell his property, where he falls in love.

title: Kumki
desc: Bomman, a mahout, and his elephant are assigned to protect the crops of a hill tribe from a rogue elephant. However, his life takes a turn when he falls in love with the village leader's daughter.

title: Yakhshee
desc: An unknown spirit protects a woman from possible threats. However, when the woman falls in love with a man, the spirit is not too happy about it.

title: Subham
desc: The women of Bheemili are unusually transfixed by a soap opera serial. When three friends who run the cable in town decide to dig into the situation, they uncover unimaginable secrets.

title: Roberrt
desc: Raghava, the head cook in a catering unit, leads a peaceful life with his son Arjun. However, their bliss is short-lived as Raghava's past comes back to haunt him.
